restore: Reuse ready C34/R1 snapshots exactly. For each case missing any core map, run one continuous frozen-core prefix and capture warm/end states. controls: Normalize raw34C and34R1 exactly as native. R134spatial =17EMAs plus their6neighbor means; R134temporal =17EMAs plus17transitions. Same support and fixed old shift selection for all.

gate: C34versusG7onidenticalheldout-videoedges. Native-pilot admission: own accepts>=G7, foreign accepts<=G7, and balanced accuracy>G7. Thus either more own at no extra foreign, fewer foreign at no own loss, or both. Same zero threshold and fixed models. This is admission only, not confirmed core benefit or ID retention.
fit: Class-balanced mean logistic loss + ||w||^2/2, fixedlambda1, free intercept, exact previous deterministicNewton, thresholdz>0. No hyperparameter/threshold/representation search. Frozen FlyVis checkpoint, no core training.
